sections.heading: Zendesk Sell ROI gate for evaluators
sections.body:
Evaluator thesis: Worth the seat spend if contact management + lead management are weekly must-haves. Counter-signal: Not worth it if Sell is one product in a larger Zendesk stack — packaging can confuse collide with your constraints.

Capability hinge for this product: contact management; lead management; pipeline management; deal management.

Integrations in research: confirm on the product hub.

Paid tiers that usually matter in evaluation: Team, Growth, Professional.

sections.heading: Who Zendesk Sell is worth it for — and who should avoid it
sections.body:
Worth it for: Choose Zendesk Sell when Zendesk CX alignment and published Sell tiers matter..

Avoid if: Compare HubSpot, Pipedrive, or Freshsales for standalone sales CRM value..

If avoid signals dominate, start the alternative path with HubSpot on the same job-to-be-done.

sections.heading: Zendesk Sell price/value and next evaluation step
sections.body:
No free/trial flag in SG data — scope a paid proof with exit criteria before annual seats.

Tradeoff to accept consciously: Published packaging clarity vs ecosystem depth.

Next step: run contact management end-to-end, then decide.
